description: Land Acquisition - Naula, Naula D/S Division, Matela District. - Amendment to the Extra Gazette No. 2251/40 of 28.10.2021 -  D/S Division Naula
categorisation: This gazette content is exclusively about land acquisition notices under the Land Acquisition Act, detailing specific land lots being acquired by the government for public purposes. It contains descriptions of land parcels, their locations, extents, and claimants, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
